{{Quote|I wonder what happened.''"<br />"''Frankly, Sir, I doubt we'll ever know.|Two [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]]|<ref name="MJBtEH6" />}}
The '''Mission to Qiaxx''' was a mission undertaken in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] by former [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] to eliminate [[Dequc]] and the [[Black Nebula (organization)|Black Nebula]].

==Background==
{{Quote|Dequc is a Jeodu who is seeking to revive Black Sun. He calls his organization Black Nebula.|[[K3]]|<ref name="MJBtEH1">[[Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand 1|''Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand'' 1]]</ref>}}
Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] was tasked by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to eliminate the leader of the [[Black Nebula (organization)|Black Nebula]] criminal organization, [[Dequc]]. She failed her [[Battle of Svivren|mission]] and was not able to pursue it due to the death of her master.<ref name="MJBtEH2">[[Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand 2|''Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand'' 2]]</ref>

[[File:Mara_fights_in_cantina.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Mara Jade fights the Black Nebula in the Phorliss cantina.]]
After her evasion from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Mara Jade traveled to the planet [[Phorliss]] in order to begin a new life. Calling herself Chiara Lorn, she begins working as a waitress in a cantina. However she was soon caught up by her past. Black Nebula goons tried to shakedown bartender [[Gorb Drig]], and end up murdering him. Enraged at the men, she ignited her [[Mara Jade's first lightsaber|lightsaber]] and slaughters the goons. She took Drig's money to use in her newfound mission: revenge on Dequc and Black Nebula.<ref name="MJBtEH4">[[Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand 4|''Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand'' 4]]</ref>

==The mission==
{{Quote|People like Dequc are the future of the galaxy. If you're smart, you'll get on board while you still can.''"<br />"''I guess that makes me not smart then.|Strok and Mara Jade|<ref name="MJBtEH6" />}}
[[File:Paltonae_arrested.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Baroness Paltonae is arrested.]]
Mara Jade made her way to the [[Bubble Cliffs]] of [[Qiaxx]], where Dequc has moved his operations. In a [[Casino/Legends|casino]], she uses [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to win enough money to gain attention to herself, posing as [[Baroness/Legends|Baroness]] Paltonae. Jade was taken to see [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Allic]], who accuses her of cheating. She pretended that a small device she had concocted has allowed her to win, and Allic arranged for her to meet Dequc, so he might purchase some of the devices. After the meeting with Allic, she scouted the place where she will meet with Dequc.<ref name="MJBtEH5" />

The next day, Mara Jade was being taken to the meeting when she caused a disturbance with the Force which allows her to stash her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] on a floating light.<ref name="MJBtEH5" /> She was then recognized by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Strok (Galactic Empire)|Strok]], her old Imperial liaison on [[Svivren/Legends|Svivren]], but managed to knock him out and accuse him of being an Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]] before he can reveal her identity. Next Mara was taken to Dequc, to whom she gives a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] of false information. She was then given a tour of the Black Nebula facilities, giving her a layout of the base. During her tour, she found Strok once again but was forced to kill the man. Dequc's forces heard the shot and pursued her, while she managed to use the Force to retrieve her lightsaber and eliminate the guards.<ref name="MJBtEH6" />

[[File:Dequc_lightsaber.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The death of [[Dequc]].]]
Mara Jade eventually found a bust of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] head and rigs it with her lightsaber inside. When she was finally caught, she pretended to be a thief stealing the bust. Once she was taken to Dequc, she telled him she was stealing it because it was also Xizor's own treasure map. When Dequc tried to investigate the bust, she activated the lightsaber, which ignited and stabed Dequc through the head. After have killed some other guards, Mara discovered Dequc's secret passage and escaped with Dequc's personal [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]].<ref name="MJBtEH6" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The ship's computer is crammed to the faceplate with Black Nebula records. With all of this, we've got a good chance of taking down the whole rat nest.|An Imperial officer|<ref name="MJBtEH6" />}}
All that the Imperial authorities find after the mission was Dequc's abandoned yacht, filled with Black Nebula computer records.<ref name="MJBtEH6" />
